definitions.gloss: auction; sale by auction; public sale
definitions.explanation: A public sale in which items are sold to the highest bidder. Used for both voluntary auctions and court-ordered forced sales of property.

examples.japanese: ⟦{美術品|びじゅつひん}→美術品：28549_bijutsuhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{競売|きょうばい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: To put artwork up for auction.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{土地|とち}→土地：02226_tochi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{競売|きょうばい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{売|う}られた→売る：00906_uru⟧。
examples.english: The land was sold at auction.

examples.japanese: ⟦{裁判所|さいばんしょ}→裁判所：09665_saibansho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{命令|めいれい}→命令：03754_meirei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧、⟦{不動産|ふどうさん}→不動産：06726_fudousan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{競売|きょうばい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦かけられる→かける：00854_kakeru⟧ことになった。
examples.english: By court order, the real estate was put up for auction.

notes:
{競売|きょうばい} is a public sale where items go to the highest bidder. It covers both voluntary auctions and court-ordered forced sales.

PRONUNCIATION:
- きょうばい: everyday reading
- けいばい: legal/formal reading used in court documents

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {競売|きょうばい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧: to put up for auction
- {競売|きょうばい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{落札|らくさつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to win at auction
- ⟦{強制|きょうせい}→強制：12500_kyousei⟧{競売|きょうばい}: forced sale (court-ordered)
- {競売|きょうばい}⟦{物件|ぶっけん}→物件：06743_bukken⟧: auctioned property

SIMILAR WORDS:
- オークション: auction (loanword, used for online and casual contexts)
- ⟦{競|せ}り→競り：16136_seri⟧: auction (especially at fish and produce markets)
- ⟦{入札|にゅうさつ}→入札：20503_nyuusatsu⟧: bidding, tendering
